integrity: The proof combines explicit upper covers with exact rational lower certificates; no numerical tolerance or external optimizer is needed for verification.
scientific_limitations: Optimality is proved only for the three stated length-six multiset types, not for the remaining two replacement rows in the motivating source.
The theorem is a classwise covering result and does not determine the global length-six covering number.
title: Optimality certificates for three length-six limited-permutation covers
